0022147b1c1d.name: Evil Sunz
0022147b1c1d.plain:
Units with this kultur:
- add 1" to their models' Move characteristic, or 2" instead for SPEED FREEKS models.
- add 1 to their Advance rolls.
- have models that ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn in which their unit Advanced.

01177c3dd9c3.name: Bounca's Jaws
01177c3dd9c3.plain: When the bearer fights, it gets 3 extra attacks, and it can never make more than 3 attacks with this weapon. For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 3 mortal wounds to the target and ends the attack sequence.

01a3d5c15559.name: Attack Out O’ Da Sun’
01a3d5c15559.plain: Use when your turn ends. Choose one of your DEFFKOPTAS units and take it off the battlefield. In your next Movement phase's Reinforcements step, you may set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model. If it is not on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

01fbcc5a733a.name: Shokk Attack Gun
01fbcc5a733a.plain: Blast. Each time you select this weapon to shoot, roll 2D6; the result is the Strength of every attack it makes. If the roll is 11+, every successful hit deals D3 mortal wounds to the target as well as its normal damage.

03756306e8ba.name: Big Mekaniak
03756306e8ba.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model can repair one of your <CLAN> VEHICLE models within 3", which gets back D3 lost wounds. A model can't be repaired more than once in the same turn.

03f7eaa77a87.name: Breakin' Heads
03f7eaa77a87.plain: When a GOFF unit within 3" of a friendly model with this ability fails a Morale test, this model may restore order by force: the unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and the Morale test then counts as passed.

047a91436895.name: Nitro Squigs
047a91436895.plain: Only a RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES model can have this. When this model attacks with its heavy squig launcha or squig launcha, add 1 to the wound roll.

0569822975f2.name: Stratagem: Big Boss
0569822975f2.plain: While mustering your army before the battle, if your WARLORD has the ORKS keyword, give one of your ORKS CHARACTER models a Warlord Trait. It must be a Warlord Trait that model could have, and the model counts as your WARLORD only for the rules of that trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (if you generate them at random, re-roll any duplicates), and this Stratagem can't be used to give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

05a1852dd7aa.name: Grand Warlord
05a1852dd7aa.plain: If your army includes this model, it has to be your WARLORD.

05f1851f70c3.name: Gun Crazy Show Offs
05f1851f70c3.plain: At the end of your Shooting phase, pick one FLASH GITZ unit from your army. It can shoot again, but it has to target the closest eligible enemy unit.

0656ad3003b3.name: Zzapkrumpaz
0656ad3003b3.plain: Only a unit that includes a Spanner model can have this. Whenever a model in this unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 also deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any normal damage.

0701677a1054.name: Speed Freeks Speed Mob
0701677a1054.plain: All units in your army get the SPEED MOB keyword, and you can use the Speed Freeks Speed Mob Stratagems, Warlord Trait and Vehicle Kustom Jobs. In a Battle-forged army, the Outrider Detachment's Command Benefits change to: +3 Command points if your WARLORD is in this Detachment. Your SPEED FREEKS units get the Adrenaline Junkies ability, and in a Battle-forged army your SPEED FREEKS BIKER units also have Objective Secured.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

07910c7ed7de.name: Full Throttle
07910c7ed7de.plain: When this unit Advances, skip the Advance roll. Instead, its models' Move characteristic is increased by 6" until the phase ends, and you roll a D6: on a 4+, this unit takes 1 mortal wound.

07a7804da8fc.name: Explodes (6+/3"/D3)
07a7804da8fc.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before you remove it and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 3" takes D3 mortal wounds.

083eb14f7591.name: Unstoppable
083eb14f7591.plain: This model can declare a charge even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

092c0ceefe62.name: Waaagh! Banner
092c0ceefe62.plain: While one of your <CLAN> ORKS units is within 6" of this model, its models add 1 to the hit roll for every melee attack they make.

09886174417a.name: Da Booma
09886174417a.plain: Only a WAGON model with a killkannon can have this. This Kustom Job takes the place of the killkannon and uses the profile listed for it.

098ff1c5cce5.name: Big Chompa's Jaws
098ff1c5cce5.plain: When the bearer fights, it gets 3 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can never make more than 3 attacks with it. For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 4 mortal wounds to the target and ends the attack sequence.

09b0b0816e4c.name: The Boss is Watchin' (Aura)
09b0b0816e4c.plain: Aura: while one of your ORKS units is within 6" of this model, you can ignore any or all modifiers to Combat Attrition tests taken for that unit.

0a450a59f864.name: Bomb Squig
0a450a59f864.plain: Once per turn, when it is chosen to shoot or to fire Overwatch, a unit that still has a bomb squig can release one. If it does, you may choose one enemy unit within 12" of it that is not AIRCRAFT (when firing Overwatch, this has to be the charging unit) and roll a D6, adding 1 to the result against a VEHICLE. On a 3+, the chosen unit takes D3 mortal wounds. Afterwards, the unit has 1 fewer bomb squig.

0a5f44daccbc.name: Spiked Ram
0a5f44daccbc.plain: After this unit has made a charge move, you can pick one enemy unit within 1" of it. Roll one D6 per model in this unit; each 4+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on that enemy unit.

0ad9796103f1.name: Has Yoo Been a Good Little Grot This Year?
0ad9796103f1.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you may choose another Gretchin unit of yours within 3" of this model. If you do, roll a D6: a 1 means that unit takes 1 mortal wound; on a 2+, its models are treated as equipped with stikkbombs for the remainder of the battle.

0b000b1aee40.name: Waaagh! Energy
0b000b1aee40.plain: While at least 20 ORKS models (not counting GRETCHIN) are within 12" of this model, it can try to manifest 1 extra psychic power in your Psychic phase.

0cd41bc24936.name: Rezmekka's Redder Paint
0cd41bc24936.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is increased by 2". When the Fight phase begins, if this WARLORD is in Engagement Range of any enemy units, none of those enemy units can be chosen to fight until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

0ddf03cd9a7c.name: Opportunist
0ddf03cd9a7c.plain:
This WARLORD:
- lets you ignore the Look Out, Sir rule whenever you pick a CHARACTER unit within 12" as its target.
- gets you 1 Command point each time an enemy VEHICLE unit is destroyed within 6" of it.

0e1aa3ea07bb.name: I'll Av Wot E's Avin!
0e1aa3ea07bb.plain: If this model is in your army, each Kustom Job can be chosen twice for your army rather than once. A model can still have only one Kustom Job.

waive.60: page reference (pg 60-61) to where the Kustom Jobs are printed, not a rule value
waive.61: page reference (pg 60-61) to where the Kustom Jobs are printed, not a rule value

0f265be73e86.name: Sawbonez
0f265be73e86.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may heal one of your <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY, <CLAN> BIKER or <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA CAVALRY models whose unit is within 3" of it. If it does, roll a D6: on a 1, that model takes 1 mortal wound; on a 2+, it regains up to 2 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn.

0f5de0f52336.name: Breakin' Heads
0f5de0f52336.plain: If one of your <CLAN> units fails a Morale test while a friendly <CLAN> WARBOSS is within 3" of it, that WARBOSS can restore order by force: the unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and the Morale test is treated as passed.

1157502a367b.name: Scorched Gitbonez
1157502a367b.plain: Only a PSYKER model can have this, and a PSYKER VEHICLE model is allowed to take it. When the bearer tries to manifest a Witchfire psychic power, add 1 to its Psychic test. Whenever the bearer would lose a wound because of Perils of the Warp, roll a D6: on a 4+, it keeps that wound.

11b4af5a8132.name: Ghazghkull’s Waaagh! Banner (Aura)
11b4af5a8132.plain: Aura: this works only while this model is within 3" of a friendly GHAZGHKULL THRAKA unit. While that is true and one of your GOFF ORKS units is within 3" of this model, roll a D6 each time a model in that GOFF ORKS unit would lose a wound; on a 6, the wound is not lost.

138165830062.name: Grabbin' Klaw
138165830062.plain: Each time it fights, the bearer is limited to a single attack with this weapon.

13d9d2a3558c.name: Grot Gunner
13d9d2a3558c.plain: Whenever a model in this unit shoots, you can choose one twin big shoota it carries. For every attack that model makes with the chosen twin big shoota, add 1 to the hit roll.

1452be516c53.name: Explodes
1452be516c53.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking it off the table. On a 6 it blows up and every unit within 3D6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

15c34b58e884.name: Red Skull Kommandos (Aura)
15c34b58e884.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD AXES KOMMANDOS units is within 6" of this model, its models add 1 to the hit roll for every melee attack they make.

16049ec6abe0.name: Grot Shields
16049ec6abe0.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase, pick one ORKS INFANTRY unit from your army, then one GRETCHIN INFANTRY unit from your army (not CHARACTER units) within 6" of it. Until the end of the phase, enemy models can't target that ORKS INFANTRY unit if that GRETCHIN INFANTRY unit is a closer visible target.

166c52faac8c.name: Kunnin' Infiltrators
166c52faac8c.plain: When you set this unit up during deployment, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from both the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

174653e3a2d8.name: Shokka Pistol
174653e3a2d8.plain: Blast. When an attack from this weapon is allocated to a VEHICLE model, its Damage characteristic is D3.

17e02bc14c43.name: Gaze of Gork (Squint)
17e02bc14c43.plain: For each attack with this profile, choose one eligible target unit. Draw a straight line between the nearest point of the bearer's base (or hull) and the nearest point of the nearest model in the target unit. Roll one wound roll against the target unit and one against each other unit that line crosses. Attacks with this profile hit the target automatically.

18750cf411ab.name: Stratagem: Extra Gubbinz
18750cf411ab.plain: While mustering your army before the battle, if your WARLORD has the ORKS keyword, give one of your ORKS CHARACTER models a Shiny Gubbinz. It must be a Relic that model could have. Every Relic in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't be used to give a model two Relics. You can use it only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

19ef2bdc0c66.name: Jabbin' Fingerz
19ef2bdc0c66.plain: MALEDICTION, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, choose one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made by models in that unit.

1b331ef6d430.name: Gaze of Gork (Glare)
1b331ef6d430.plain: Blast. Whenever this profile is chosen, pick a point on the battlefield within this weapon's maximum range. Resolve attacks against each eligible enemy unit within 3" of that point, working out visibility from that point. Work out the number of attacks separately for each eligible enemy unit.

1b3c445608ce.name: Charge Through ’Em!
1b3c445608ce.plain: Use just before one of your KULT OF SPEED units consolidates. Its consolidation distance is 2D6" rather than 3".

1b84e802b1a0.name: Frazzle
1b84e802b1a0.plain: WITCHFIRE, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, roll a D6 for every enemy unit within 9" of this PSYKER: on a 4+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

1c1da20af42f.name: Grukk's Meanest Ladz
1c1da20af42f.plain: Each NOBZ model in this unit gets 1 extra attack (add 1 to its Attacks characteristic) as long as the unit is within 6" of a friendly GRUKK FACE-RIPPA model.

1d87890ce329.name: Orks Is Never Beaten
1d87890ce329.plain: Use in the Fight phase when one of your ORKS CHARACTER models that hasn't been picked to fight yet this phase is destroyed. Leave the model in play: it can fight after the unit of the model that attacked it has made all its attacks. If its characteristics change as it loses wounds, resolve those attacks using the bottom row of its profile. Once its attacks are resolved, remove it.

1de3e95d5627.name: Fight Detecta
1de3e95d5627.plain: One of your BLOOD AXES CORE units can charge an enemy unit that has just arrived near the bearer. In your opponent's Movement phase, once the Reinforcements step ends: if an enemy unit arrived as Reinforcements this turn within 12" of the bearer, you may choose one of your BLOOD AXES CORE units that is within 6" of the bearer and not in Engagement Range of any enemy units. That BLOOD AXES unit may declare a charge as though it were your Charge phase, but the only target it may choose is that enemy unit, and you add 2 to the charge roll.

1e07d5fa0576.name: No Clan
1e07d5fa0576.plain: Your army can include units from several Clans and Mobs, but you can't use some of the Clan Kulturs and Subkulturs.

1e72586fc3e8.name: Grot Gunner and Targetin' Squig
1e72586fc3e8.plain: When a model in this unit attacks with a kustom shokk rifle, that model counts as having Ballistic Skill 3+ for the attack.

1eb82fc703de.name: Terrain Traits (Mekboy Workshop)
1eb82fc703de.plain: Every piece of this terrain feature is an Obstacle, and has the following traits: Light Cover, Heavy Cover, Defence Line, Difficult Ground, Defensible, Unstable Position.

1ed779745354.name: Goffs
1ed779745354.plain:
Models with this kultur:
- score 1 extra hit for each unmodified hit roll of 6 they make in melee.
- add 1 to the Strength characteristic of their melee attacks if their unit made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention this turn.

1ee45c210310.name: BeastGob (Aura)
1ee45c210310.plain: Aura: while one of your <CLAN> SQUIG units is within 6" of this WARLORD, add 1 to the Damage of its models' melee attacks with the jaws weapons named here. These are squighog jaws, smasha squig jaws and a squigosaur's jaws.

1f4466e4e6b0.name: Big Boss
1f4466e4e6b0.plain: Once per battle, in your Command phase, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you can call a Waaagh! even though it isn't a WARBOSS model. Only Stage 1 of that Waaagh! takes effect as normal; Stage 2 does not. This Enhancement can't be given to a WARBOSS model.

1fb3ab5b04c3.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D3 Transport)
1fb3ab5b04c3.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

1fd4163620f3.name: Burna Bomb
1fd4163620f3.plain: Once per turn, if the bearer still has a burna bomb, it can drop it. To do so, after the bearer makes a Normal Move or Advances in your Movement phase, pick a point on the battlefield that it passed over this phase, then roll a D6 for every model within 6" of that point. Subtract 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER model (unless it is a VEHICLE or MONSTER model). On a 5+ the model's unit takes 1 mortal wound. No burna bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. Since the January 2023 update, this only works if the bearer is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

203de91e6fbd.name: Giga Shoota
203de91e6fbd.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks with this weapon against a target within half range.

20a3bdd851f1.name: Mek Connections
20a3bdd851f1.plain: Use when your Movement phase ends, choosing one of your DREAD WAAAGH! units within 1" of a MEK WORKSHOP. If that unit is given a kustom job through the Kustom Job ability, it receives something 'extra speshul' on a 4+ instead of needing a 6+.

20ec8e7d9607.name: Kustom Red Button
20ec8e7d9607.plain: Once per battle, when your Command phase begins, you may have the driver push the red button on his dashboard. If you do, roll a D6 to see what happens. 1 Skreenwipers: no effect. 2-3 Boosta: this model's Move characteristic is increased by 3" until your next Command phase. 4-5 Extra Spikes: until your next Command phase, whenever this model finishes a charge move, roll a D6 for every enemy unit within Engagement Range; each one that rolls 4+ takes D3 mortal wounds. 6 More Dakka: until your next Command phase, on this model's ranged attacks an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit.

2218ca8156f0.name: Waaagh! Effigy (Aura)
2218ca8156f0.plain: Aura: you can re-roll Morale tests for friendly ORKS units while they are within 6" of this model.

228c613a328b.name: Warboss (Aura)
228c613a328b.plain: Aura: while one of your <CLAN> CORE or <CLAN> CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, its models add 1 to the hit roll for every melee attack they make.

229a2fbb229b.name: Da Jump
229a2fbb229b.plain: BLESSING, warp charge 7. If it is manifested, choose one of your <CLAN> CORE units within 12" of this PSYKER. Take that unit off the battlefield and place it again anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" away from all enemy models.

239685668d94.name: Gyroscopic Whirlygig
239685668d94.plain: Only a SHOKKJUMP DRAGSTA model can have this. This model ignores any mortal wounds it would suffer from its Shokk Tunnel ability.

23ef0220236b.name: Tellyporta
23ef0220236b.plain: Use during deployment. Choose one of your non-MONSTER ORKS units whose Power Rating is 20 or less; you may set it up on a tellyporta pad rather than on the battlefield. If you do, it can arrive in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases: place it on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from every enemy model. If it is a TRANSPORT unit, units embarked in it stay embarked when it arrives.

24618ff23900.name: Da Killa Klaw
24618ff23900.plain: Only a model with a power klaw can have this. It takes the place of the power klaw and uses the profile listed for this Relic.

24ecd0dd78b1.name: Suspiciously Lucky
24ecd0dd78b1.plain: This model has a 2+ invulnerable save. Once an invulnerable save for this model fails, this ability stops working for the rest of the battle.

24fdb57ebdd6.name: Snakebitez - Brogs Buzzbomb
24fdb57ebdd6.plain: Blast. This weapon can shoot at units the bearer can't see. The bearer can shoot it only once per battle. Its attacks hit on a hit roll of 2+, no matter what modifiers apply. Once it has been fired, every unit within 6" of the target takes 1 mortal wound.

25c28156c6c3.name: Souped-Up Speshul
25c28156c6c3.plain: Only a BOOMDAKKA SNAZZWAGONS model can have this. This model's Mek speshul has its Type changed to 'Dakka 16/12'.

25c33ffad2db.name: Stikka (Shooting)
25c33ffad2db.plain: When this weapon attacks a unit within half range, the attack gets +1 Strength.

2608d8ed87dc.name: Extra Kunnin'
2608d8ed87dc.plain: Once per battle round, when you use a Strategic Ploy Stratagem while this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can make it cost 1CP less. The saving only applies to that one use; later uses of that Stratagem cost the normal number of CPs.

264c416bf2f5.name: Hit ’Em Harder
264c416bf2f5.plain: Use in the Fight phase when one of your MEGANOBZ units is picked to fight. For the rest of the phase, attacks its models make with a power klaw or killsaw get 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

26c3a993f970.name: Morgog's Finkin' Cap
26c3a993f970.plain: Only a BLOOD AXE model can have this, and a VEHICLE model is allowed to take it. When your Command phase starts, if the bearer is on the battlefield, you may roll a D6: on a 4+, you get 1 Command point.

27a949a9f866.name: Boom Boyz
27a949a9f866.plain: The unit gains the BOOM BOYZ keyword and this ability: whenever a BOOM BOYZ model shoots with a Blast weapon, improve that attack's Armour Penetration by 1. Only BIG MEK, DEFFKOPTAS, MEK, NOB, TANKBUSTAS, WAGON or WARBOSS units can take this.

289c1445dc64.name: Stompa Mob
289c1445dc64.plain: Use while choosing your army: make one of your ORK Super-heavy Detachments a Stompa Mob Specialist Detachment, and its STOMPA units get the STOMPA MOB keyword. You can also give the CHARACTER keyword to one model in that Specialist Detachment; however, it can only be given Gork's One or Mork's One as a Warlord Trait, and Tezdrek's Stompa Power Field is the only relic it can take.

28ad1ee81498.name: Adrenaline Junkies
28ad1ee81498.plain: This unit can never have a Clan Kultur, but its presence in a Detachment doesn't prevent the Detachment's other units (other than ones that also have this ability) from getting one. Whenever this unit fights, if it made a charge move or a Heroic Intervention this turn, its models get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic until that fight has been resolved. If it Advances during your Movement phase, it is treated as having made a Normal Move instead, up to the end of your Shooting phase. Its models have a 6+ invulnerable save, which becomes 5+ from the moment it is picked to Advance in your Movement phase until your next Movement phase starts.

29572a41ee55.name: Killsaw
29572a41ee55.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon. When the bearer fights, if it has 2 killsaws, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon.

296151176d6f.name: Da Beast
296151176d6f.plain: When this model Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, its Move characteristic is increased by 6" until the phase ends.

29939f853bbd.name: Explodes
29939f853bbd.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 3" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

299b901b596a.name: Explodes (6"/3D6/D6)
299b901b596a.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking it off the table. On a 6 it blows up and every unit within 3D6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

2a1a5b5a89dc.name: Explodes (6+/2D6"/D6)
2a1a5b5a89dc.plain: Roll a D6 when this model is reduced to 0 wounds, before taking it off the battlefield and before any embarked models get out. On a 6 it blows up, and each unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

2b554e30b3de.name: Flashiest Gitz (Aura)
2b554e30b3de.plain: Aura: while one of your FLASH GITZ units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

2d37c0eeaee8.name: Trigga Discipline
2d37c0eeaee8.plain: Use in your Shooting phase when one of your BLOOD AXES LOOTAS units is picked to shoot. Choose an enemy VEHICLE unit; for the rest of the phase, attacks by that LOOTAS unit's models against that VEHICLE unit can re-roll the hit roll. It costs 1CP if the LOOTAS unit has up to 10 models, or 2CP if it has more.

2d47ee54ea98.name: Wreckaz
2d47ee54ea98.plain: Use when your Shooting phase or Fight phase starts, choosing one of your DEATHSKULLS CORE or DEATHSKULLS CHARACTER units. For the rest of the phase, its models' attacks against a VEHICLE get 1 added to the wound roll.

2df430e547fb.name: Roar of Mork
2df430e547fb.plain: Malediction (Aura): one enemy unit subtracts 2 from its Advance and charge rolls, and nearby enemy units lose 1 Leadership. Choose one enemy unit within 18" of the PSYKER that it can see: until the start of your next Psychic phase, its Advance and charge rolls are reduced by 2 each. Also, until the start of your next Psychic phase, any enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER has its models' Leadership characteristic reduced by 1 while it is there.

2f349d758955.name: Beasthide Mantle
2f349d758955.plain: Only a BEAST SNAGGA model can have this. The bearer gets 1 extra attack (add 1 to its Attacks characteristic). Whenever the bearer would lose a wound, roll a D6: on a 5+, it keeps that wound.

3093ceaf1545.name: Scrag 'Em
3093ceaf1545.plain: While this unit has 3 or more models, its models get 1 extra attack each.

30cf92f2cce7.name: Kustom Red Button (Looted 'Eavy Wagon)
30cf92f2cce7.plain: Once per battle, when your Command phase begins, you may have the driver push the red button on his dashboard. If you do, roll a D6 to see what happens. 1 SHOUTY SPEAKAS: no effect. 2-3 BOOTA: this model's Move characteristic is increased by 4" until your next Command phase. 4-5 MORE DAKKA: until your next Command phase, on this model's ranged attacks an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit. 6 FORCE FIELDS: this model gets a 5+ invulnerable save until your next Command phase.

312dd3612aa0.name: Follow me Ladz!
312dd3612aa0.plain: After this WARLORD makes a charge move, your <CLAN> ORKS units add 1 to charge rolls against enemy units within Engagement Range of it for the rest of the turn. This applies each time one of those units declares a charge against such an enemy unit.

31a2f2c8d353.name: Tankhammer
31a2f2c8d353.plain: This weapon can make only 1 attack each time the bearer fights. On a hit, the target unit takes D6 mortal wounds and the bearer is destroyed.

32bff9046434.name: Fasta Than Yooz
32bff9046434.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your EVIL SUNZ CORE units within 6" of this model: it can declare a charge even if it Advanced or Fell Back this turn.

332aa3a855b4.name: Ded Chewy Blasta
332aa3a855b4.plain: Blast. If you roll any unmodified hit rolls of 1 for this weapon's attacks, the bearer takes 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon.

33a5b05f2ede.name: Showin’ Off
33a5b05f2ede.plain: Use when one of your BAD MOONS CORE or BAD MOONS CHARACTER units is picked to shoot. For the rest of the phase, its models' Dakka weapon attacks score 1 additional hit on each unmodified hit roll of 6.

385882d70958.name: Krusha Kannon - Tankhamma shell
385882d70958.plain: You can re-roll the hit roll for attacks with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit.

39d901b8af5e.name: Super Cybork Body
39d901b8af5e.plain: Only an INFANTRY model can have this. This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, and whenever an attack is allocated to it, that attack's Damage characteristic is halved.

3aa258d8a965.name: Da Boss is Watchin’ (Aura)
3aa258d8a965.plain: Aura: while one of your ORKS units is within 6" of this model, you can ignore any or all modifiers to Combat Attrition tests taken for that unit.

3adbf4147097.name: Taktical Awareness
3adbf4147097.plain: Use when any phase starts. Choose one of your BLOOD AXES units. Until the turn ends, it may begin an action even though it Advanced this turn, its ranged attacks don't make any action it is doing fail, and, if it has the CHARACTER keyword, its aura abilities keep working while it performs an action.

3b05cb9ce513.name: Unbridled Carnage
3b05cb9ce513.plain: Use when the Fight phase starts. Choose one of your GOFF CORE or GOFF CHARACTER units that has the No Mukkin' About Clan Kultur. For the rest of the phase, its models' attacks score an extra hit on an unmodified hit roll of 5+ instead of 6.

3b5ca179de88.name: Mob Rule
3b5ca179de88.plain: As long as this unit is within 6" of one of your <CLAN> MOB units that is not under half strength, this unit never counts as being under half strength.

3b6d3483b21e.name: SPEEDWAAAGH!
3b6d3483b21e.plain: At the start of the Charge phase, any of your <CLAN> BIKER and VEHICLE units within 6" of this model may still charge, even having Advanced this turn.

3b9f5486cf19.name: Wing Missiles
3b9f5486cf19.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks made with this weapon against a VEHICLE unit.

3bfc9c01c112.name: Gitfinda Squig
3bfc9c01c112.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of every ranged attack this model makes.

3c1975df813e.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D3)
3c1975df813e.plain: When this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

3c3cfa9e1dcd.name: Dakka Weapons
3c3cfa9e1dcd.plain: A Dakka weapon has two numbers of attacks. When a model fires one, use the first number if the target is within half the weapon's range; otherwise use the second number.

3cadc6d0f77d.name: Pyromaniacs
3cadc6d0f77d.plain: When a PYROMANIACS model shoots one of the weapons listed here and rolls for its number of attacks, it always makes at least 3 attacks. If the dice would give fewer than 3 attacks, it makes 3 instead. The weapons are: burnas, skorchas, burna bottles, burna exhausts, killa jets, skorcha missile racks, the Skorcha profile or kombi-skorchas.

3d28fad90b4b.name: Ork Detachment Abilities
3d28fad90b4b.plain: In ORKS Detachments, <CLAN> units (except GRETCHIN units) gain the Clan Kulturs ability, and Troops units (except GRETCHIN units) gain the Objective Secured ability.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

3e1ec364c0ad.name: Pointy Decorashunz!
3e1ec364c0ad.plain: Once this unit has finished a charge move, you may pick one enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a D6: on a 4+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

3efa9de5b3cf.name: Deff Rolla
3efa9de5b3cf.plain: For attacks with this weapon, the bearer counts as having Weapon Skill 2+.

3efff4288a2f.name: Drive by Dakka
3efff4288a2f.plain: At the end of your Shooting phase, pick one EVIL SUNZ SPEED FREEKS unit from your army. It can immediately make a Normal Move as if it were your Movement phase, but it can't charge this turn.

403222f9d644.name: Open-Topped
403222f9d644.plain: In your Shooting phase, units embarked in this transport can be chosen to shoot; measure range and line of sight from any point on the transport. If the transport made a Normal Move, Advanced or Fell Back this turn, the embarked units count as having done the same. While the transport is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, embarked units can only shoot with Pistols.

407cd38bfc46.name: Breakin’ Heads
407cd38bfc46.plain: Use in the Morale phase, when one of your <CLAN> units (not GRETCHIN units) fails a Morale test while a friendly <CLAN> WARBOSS or <CLAN> NOBZ unit is within 3" of it. The <CLAN> unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and the test counts as passed.

409bbc1b82a8.name: Speshul Ammo
409bbc1b82a8.plain: Use in your Shooting phase when one of your BLOOD AXES units is picked to shoot. For the rest of the phase, the shootas its models carry become Type Dakka 4/2 with Armour Penetration -1 (kombi-weapons' Shoota profile included). It costs 1CP for a unit of up to 10 models, or 2CP for a larger unit.

454830a978e2.name: Skrak's horned helmet
454830a978e2.plain: When the bearer fights, it can make 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can only ever make 1 attack with it. If that attack scores a hit, the target takes 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

45b037661160.name: Kill Tank Grot Riggers
45b037661160.plain: When each of your Movement phases ends, this model gets back up to D3 lost wounds. It can't be repaired more than once per turn.

45e957043e54.name: Drill Boss (Aura)
45e957043e54.plain: Aura: while one of your GOFF STORMBOYZ units is within 6" of this model, whenever that unit fails a Morale test, then for the rest of the phase, halve the number of its models that flee because of failed Combat Attrition tests (round fractions down).

48b9ddb3f302.name: Freebooterz
48b9ddb3f302.plain: Each time one of your FREEBOOTERZ units destroys an enemy unit, your other FREEBOOTERZ units with this kultur add 1 to hit rolls until the end of the phase. This starts once the attacks of the unit that destroyed the enemy have been resolved.

497b90788534.name: Morbad's Gitgrabba
497b90788534.plain: This weapon has the Gotcha! ability. You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.

4a942181d985.name: Headwoppa's Killchoppa
4a942181d985.plain: Only a model with a beastchoppa, big choppa or 'uge choppa can have this. It takes the place of that weapon and uses the profile listed for this Relic.

4b7bef328e16.name: Ramshackle
4b7bef328e16.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to this model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1), unless the attack has Strength 8 or higher.

4c12910e10c6.name: Turbo-boostas
4c12910e10c6.plain: Use as your Movement phase begins, choosing one of your KULT OF SPEED units. If it Advances this phase, don't roll a dice: its Move characteristic is doubled instead.

4c2069e0f806.name: Kult of Speed
4c2069e0f806.plain: When you choose your army, pick one ORK Detachment in your army to become a Kult of Speed Specialist Detachment. SPEED FREEKS in it gain the KULT OF SPEED keyword.

4cd7bcd592e5.name: 'Urty Syringe
4cd7bcd592e5.plain: When the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon. Attacks with this weapon succeed on a wound roll of 6+ against a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, and on a wound roll of 4+ against anything else.

4d2577bad747.name: Blood Axes
4d2577bad747.plain:
Units with this kultur:
- count as having the benefits of light cover against ranged attacks from attackers more than 18" away.
- may either shoot or declare a charge in a turn when they Fell Back, but not both.

4e7a3491a7be.name: Grot Gunner (Boostas)
4e7a3491a7be.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks with a grot blasta, add 1 to the hit roll for that attack.

4ea981ee4301.name: Icon of da Revolushun
4ea981ee4301.plain: For attacks with this weapon, a wound roll of 6+ also deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of any other damage.

4f6852bdb447.name: Open-Topped (Big'ed Bossbunka)
4f6852bdb447.plain: In your Shooting phase, units embarked in this transport can be chosen to shoot; measure ranges and line of sight from any point on the transport. Embarked models count as having Remained Stationary unless they embarked this turn.

504b3a6397f5.name: Dok's Toolz (Aura)
504b3a6397f5.plain: Aura: while one of your <CLAN> INFANTRY or <CLAN> BIKER units is within 3" of this model, roll a D6 whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound; on a 6, the wound is not lost.

50605f209e4d.name: Grot Riggers (Battle Fortress)
50605f209e4d.plain: In your Command phase, this model gets back up to 1 lost wound.

528621efd0ea.name: Krush ’Em
528621efd0ea.plain: Use when one of your BLITZ BRIGADE BONEBREAKA models is picked to fight in the Fight phase. For its Bonebreaka Ram ability, roll three D6 and keep the highest.

52a47593677e.name: Trukk Boyz
52a47593677e.plain:
The unit gains the TRUKK BOYZ keyword and this ability:
- TRUKK BOYZ units may disembark from a TRUKK even after it has made a Normal Move this phase.
- A TRUKK adds 1 to the hit roll of each of its ranged attacks while any TRUKK BOYZ units are embarked in it.
Only BOYZ, NOB or WARBOSS units can take this.

5329cd244f95.name: Da Bigger Dey Iz...
5329cd244f95.plain: Use in the Fight phase when one of your BEAST SNAGGA WARBOSS units is picked to fight. For the rest of the phase, its models' attacks that target a TITANIC unit get 2 added to their Damage characteristic.

544a7d580ffa.name: Warpath
544a7d580ffa.plain: Blessing, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, choose one of your <CLAN> CORE or <CLAN> CHARACTER units within 18" of this PSYKER. Its models get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic until the start of your next Psychic phase.

5491229c555e.name: Da Souped-up Shokka
5491229c555e.plain: Blast. Whenever this unit is selected to shoot with this weapon, roll once to set the weapon's Strength. If the result is 11+, each successful hit also deals D3 mortal wounds to the target on top of its normal damage.

57b3cf1f5fb7.name: Artillery and Crew
57b3cf1f5fb7.plain: Each Mek Gun and its crew count as one model for all rules purposes, and the crew models have to stay within 1" of their Mek Gun. So the crew can't be targeted or attacked on their own, and visibility and all ranges are measured to and from the Mek Gun model, not the crew. This unit can't Advance, is never eligible to charge or perform a Heroic Intervention, and can't pile in or consolidate.

580a36617300.name: Stompa Lifta-Droppa
580a36617300.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon hits, roll 3D6. If the total is higher than the target's Toughness characteristic, the attack successfully wounds.

581fe93d0232.name: Boom Bomb
581fe93d0232.plain: Once per turn, the bearer can drop one of the boom bombs it still has. Do this in your Movement phase, once the bearer has made a Normal Move or Advanced: pick a point on the battlefield that it crossed during this phase. Roll a D6 for every unit within 6" of that point, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit that is not a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. On a 4+, the unit takes D3 mortal wounds, or D6 mortal wounds instead if you rolled a 6. No boom bomb can be dropped more than once per battle.

58353361eaae.name: Super Runts
58353361eaae.plain: At the start of the first battle round, choose one GRETCHIN CORE unit in your army to be Zodgrod's super runts. Models in that unit add 1 to the hit roll for every attack they make, and the unit can shoot while performing an action without that action failing.

584412b4821c.name: Big Boss
584412b4821c.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ORKS keyword: pick one ORKS CHARACTER from your army and give it one Warlord Trait (one it is allowed to have). That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. All Warlord Traits in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if rolling randomly), and this Stratagem can't give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

58e777eebddf.name: Da Fixer Upperz
58e777eebddf.plain: Only a DEATHSKULLS MEK or BIG MEK model can have this. Whenever the bearer uses its Mekaniak or Big Mekaniak ability, roll a D6. On a 2+, the VEHICLE unit it chose gets back 1 extra wound, and you may also pick an enemy VEHICLE unit within 12" of the bearer: that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

591b4a065f27.name: Stompa Mob
591b4a065f27.plain: When choosing your army, make one ORK Super-heavy Detachment in your army a Stompa Mob Specialist Detachment; its STOMPA units gain the STOMPA MOB keyword. You can also give one model in that Detachment the CHARACTER keyword. If you do, Gork's One or Mork's One is the only Warlord Trait it can be given, and Tezdrek's Stompa Power Field is the only relic it can take.

59fd75df17f5.name: Kombi-weapon with rokkit launcha
59fd75df17f5.plain: Each time you attack with this weapon, pick one or both of the profiles below. If you pick both, all of its hit rolls get 1 subtracted.

59ff65c00a25.name: Workshop
59ff65c00a25.plain: When this fortification is set up, all Scrap Piles and Scrap Barricades have to be placed within 6" of the Mekboy Workbench. After set-up, each piece of the Fortification counts as a terrain feature.

5a6ac771fc13.name: Careen!
5a6ac771fc13.plain: Use in any phase when one of your ORKS VEHICLE models is destroyed and explodes while not within Engagement Range of any enemy models. Before the explosion is resolved, it can make a Normal Move of up to 6". Costs 2CP for a WAGON or TITANIC VEHICLE, 1CP for any other.

5ae341239082.name: Smoky Gubbinz
5ae341239082.plain: Only for a unit containing a Spanner model. If this unit Remained Stationary, it gains the benefits of light cover, lasting until your next Movement phase.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book", a page reference the style guide says to drop

5b4d810544aa.name: Ram
5b4d810544aa.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge, choose an enemy unit it is in Engagement Range of and roll a D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

5c7fe34d4afc.name: One Scalpel Short of a Medpak
5c7fe34d4afc.plain: This model can charge even in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. At the start of the Charge phase, if it is able to charge, it must declare a charge, and the nearest enemy unit must be one of its targets.

5c9584c7ad88.name: Drag Chains
5c9584c7ad88.plain: Only a SPEED MOB VEHICLE model can have this. In your Movement phase, whenever this model is chosen to Fall Back, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it (not a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit) and roll a D6. On a 2-5, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, it takes 3 mortal wounds.

5ce37ea454c2.name: Wurrboy
5ce37ea454c2.plain: Psychic powers: Smite, plus 2 powers from the Beasthead discipline.

5d042a80bec7.name: Rippa Klaws
5d042a80bec7.plain: If the bearer has 2 dread rippa klaws, then whenever it fights it can make 1 extra attack with 1 of those dread rippa klaws.

5ee2e968f6b7.name: Snagga Grapple
5ee2e968f6b7.plain: At the start of your opponent's Movement phase, pick one BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ unit from your army. Whenever an enemy unit (not TITANIC units) within Engagement Range of that unit is chosen to move, roll one D6: on a 4+, it can't Fall Back this turn.

5f72945fcef6.name: Smasha 'Ead
5f72945fcef6.plain: Whenever this model ends a charge move or a Heroic Intervention move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll five D6. That unit suffers 1 mortal wound for every 4+.

607807822357.name: Stampede
607807822357.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge, choose an enemy unit it is in Engagement Range of and roll a D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

623fa7904162.name: Might is Right
623fa7904162.plain: The bearer adds 1 to its Strength and Attacks characteristics.

62b6e77dac66.name: Enhanced Runt-sucker
62b6e77dac66.plain: Only a BIG MEK with a shokk attack gun can have this. The shokk attack gun's Type becomes 'Heavy 2D3'.

631775a44e5a.name: Grot Lash
631775a44e5a.plain: Aura: while one of your GRETCHIN INFANTRY units is within 3" of any models with a grot-lash, its models' Move characteristic is increased by 1". The bearer gains this as its Grot Lash (Aura) ability.

631dc9dc5ed4.name: Da Krushin' Armour
631dc9dc5ed4.plain: Only a MEGA ARMOUR model can have this. The bearer has a 4+ invulnerable save, and you add 1 to its armour saves. After the bearer finishes a charge move, you may pick one enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a D6: on a 2+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

63ec63a867f4.name: Da Badskull Banner
63ec63a867f4.plain: Only a FREEBOOTERZ model can have this, and a VEHICLE model is allowed to take it. Any enemy unit within 6" of the bearer loses its Objective Secured ability for as long as it stays there.

656d5edb2aa8.name: Howdah
656d5edb2aa8.plain: During your Shooting phase, units embarked on this model are allowed to shoot; measure their range and line of sight from any point on it. While shooting, these units are not treated as being in Engagement Range of enemy units, and if this model Fell Back or made a Normal Move, they are treated as having Remained Stationary. Every other restriction or modifier affecting this model also affects the models embarked on it; for example, if this model Advanced, so did they.

663c4d885cb8.name: Mekaniak Boss
663c4d885cb8.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, you may have Mek Boss Buzzgob repair one of your GOFF VEHICLE units within 3" of him; that VEHICLE model regains up to 3 lost wounds. A model can't be repaired more than once in the same turn.

664ae0a8d9d8.name: Squiggly Curse
664ae0a8d9d8.plain: WITCHFIRE, warp charge 7. If it is manifested, choose one enemy unit within 12" of this PSYKER and roll a D6 for every model in it, up to a maximum of 6 dice. For each 4+, that unit takes 1 mortal wound. If this power destroys any models in that unit, every other enemy unit within 6" of it takes 1 mortal wound.

66860e26b971.name: Big Krumpaz
66860e26b971.plain: The unit gains the Krumpin' Time ability: add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack made by a BIG KRUMPAZ model. Only these units can take this: DEFF DREADS, GORKANAUT, MEGA ARMOUR NOBZ, MEGA ARMOUR CHARACTER or MORKANAUT.

68a3188e0534.name: Sawbonez
68a3188e0534.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may try surgery on one of your <CLAN> INFANTRY or <CLAN> BIKER models within 3". If it does, roll a D6: on a 1, that model loses 1 wound; on any other result, it regains D3 lost wounds. No model can have surgery tried on it more than once per turn.

6950386a8203.name: Spirit of Gork

69caaa7119da.name: Squigstoppa
69caaa7119da.plain: When the Fight phase starts, you may pick one enemy MONSTER unit within 6" of this model and roll a D6. On a 2+, that unit can't fight this phase until every eligible unit in your army has fought.

6aa7d640f84e.name: Supa-Skorcha
6aa7d640f84e.plain: Attacks made with this weapon hit the target automatically.

6b2424279444.name: Git-rippa
6b2424279444.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon.

6bf24308be6b.name: Kannonwagon Grot Gunners
6bf24308be6b.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll whenever this model attacks with a super-kannon.

6c0c29fb3ca8.name: Killa Jet (Cutta)
6c0c29fb3ca8.plain: When an attack made with this profile targets a unit within half range, that attack's Damage characteristic is D6+2.

6c0c66e99263.name: Explodes (6+/3"/1)
6c0c66e99263.plain: When this model is reduced to 0 wounds, roll a D6 before you remove it and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

6d8a9e372275.name: Buzzgob's Dredheadz
6d8a9e372275.plain: In your Command phase, you may pick one of your GOFF MORKANAUT, GOFF GORKANAUT, GOFF KILLA KANS, GOFF MEKA DREAD, GOFF MEGA DREAD or GOFF DEFF DREADS units within 6" of Mek Boss Buzzgob. Until your next Command phase starts, models in that unit add 1 to the hit roll for every attack they make.

6df63adf137e.name: Dread Waaagh!
6df63adf137e.plain: Use while choosing your army: make one of your ORK Detachments a Dread Waaagh! Specialist Detachment. Its BIG MEKS, KILLA KANS, DEFF DREADS, GORKANAUTS and MORKANAUTS get the DREAD WAAAGH! keyword.

7000590f8dba.name: Roadkilla
7000590f8dba.plain: Once this WARLORD has finished a charge move, you may pick one enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

71ac8d985d04.name: Bitin' Jawz
71ac8d985d04.plain: WITCHFIRE, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, choose one enemy model within 18" of this PSYKER that it can see. Trace a line from any part of this PSYKER's base to any part of that model's base (or hull). The chosen model's unit takes 1 mortal wound, and so does every other enemy unit the line crosses over or passes through.

73b15adef8bb.name: I've Got A Plan, Ladz!
73b15adef8bb.plain: At the end of the Deploy Armies step, you can pick up to three of your BLOOD AXES units and set them up again (redeploy them). When the mission uses Strategic Reserves, you can put any of them into Strategic Reserves without spending extra CPs, no matter how many units are in Strategic Reserves already. If both players have abilities that let them redeploy units, they roll off, and the winner picks which player redeploys first.

74a827878551.name: 'Eadbanger
74a827878551.plain: WITCHFIRE, warp charge 5. If it is manifested, choose one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER and roll a D6. If the roll beats that unit's Toughness characteristic, the unit takes D6 mortal wounds. These mortal wounds can destroy at most one model; any damage left over is lost.

7640ef7b0e6d.name: Unstoppable Momentum
7640ef7b0e6d.plain: Use in your Charge phase once one of your NOB ON SMASHA SQUIG units has finished a charge move. If that model has no enemy models in Engagement Range, it can straight away be picked to declare another charge.

765abaf55649.name: Grot Riggers
765abaf55649.plain: Roll a D6 at the end of the turn: on a 6, this model gets back 1 lost wound.

767701ccd595.name: Grot Oiler
767701ccd595.plain: Once per battle, a VEHICLE model repaired by the bearer can regain 1 extra lost wound. (A Grot Oiler model can be placed beside the unit as a reminder and removed once used; it is not a model for any rules purposes.)

76955a8bca09.name: Proper Killy
76955a8bca09.plain:
This WARLORD:
- adds 1 to its Attacks characteristic.
- improves the Armour Penetration characteristic of its melee attacks by 1.

76d07bbf0c82.name: Blitz Brigade
76d07bbf0c82.plain: Use while choosing your army: make one of your ORK Detachments a Blitz Brigade Specialist Detachment. Its WARBOSSES, BATTLEWAGONS, GUNWAGONS and BONEBREAKA units get the BLITZ BRIGADE keyword.

76d34f0e01dc.name: I've Got Just da Fing
76d34f0e01dc.plain: Your MEK and BIG MEK units can attempt the Kustomise action. Kustomise (Action): at the end of your Movement phase (no more than once per battle round), choose a MEK or BIG MEK unit of yours within 1" of the Mekboy Workbench, plus an ORKS VEHICLE (TITANIC units excluded) within 3" of that Workbench. The VEHICLE unit must stay within 3" of the Workbench until the action completes, which happens when your turn ends. Then choose a Kustom Job the VEHICLE unit is eligible for, respecting the usual limits on how many times each Kustom Job can appear in your army (see I'll Av Wot E's Avin!). The VEHICLE unit gains it, and its Power Rating and points value don't increase. When each battle round ends, roll a D6 for every Kustom Job gained this way: on a 1 that Kustom Job falls off, and that model can't use or select it again for the rest of the battle.
