waive.61: page reference (pg 60-61) to where the Kustom Jobs are printed, not a rule value

7754f2725edd.name: 'Urty Syringe
7754f2725edd.plain: The bearer gets 1 extra attack with this weapon each time it fights. Attacks with this weapon always wound on an unmodified wound roll of 2+, except against a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit.

7959b65c98a2.name: Explodes
7959b65c98a2.plain: Whenever a model in this unit is destroyed, roll a D6 before you remove it from play. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 3" takes D3 mortal wounds.

796b4afcffb5.name: Cowardly
796b4afcffb5.plain: If no friendly RUNTHERD model is within 6" of this unit, subtract 1 from the result of every Combat Attrition test a model in this unit takes.

7a0a6d69a45f.name: Explodes
7a0a6d69a45f.plain: Roll a D6 when this model is destroyed. On a 6 it blows up, inflicting D3 mortal wounds on every unit within 3".

7a4b930154a7.name: Goffs is da Best (Aura)
7a4b930154a7.plain: Aura: while one of your GOFF CORE or GOFF CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit can re-roll the hit roll for their melee attacks.

7ac531010835.name: Kustom Force Field
7ac531010835.plain: Aura: while one of your ORKS units is within 6" of the bearer, that unit has a 6+ invulnerable save. Nothing can increase the range of this aura unless a rule specifically says it can.

7ae506f134dd.name: Half-Chewed
7ae506f134dd.plain: This Warlord can avoid losing wounds while it is in Engagement Range of an enemy CHARACTER or MONSTER unit. Whenever this model would lose a wound while that is true, roll a D6: on a 4+, it keeps that wound.

7aec93eb5bc5.name: Waaagh!
7aec93eb5bc5.plain: Waaagh! (WARLORD is a WARBOSS): in your Command phase, once per battle, you can call a Waaagh! if that WARBOSS is on the battlefield or embarked in a TRANSPORT on the battlefield. Speedwaaagh! (WARLORD is a SPEEDBOSS): in your Command phase, once per battle, you can instead call a Speedwaaagh!, if that SPEEDBOSS is on the battlefield. Great Waaagh! (WARLORD is GHAZGHKULL THRAKA): you can call a Great Waaagh! instead, if GHAZGHKULL THRAKA is on the battlefield or embarked in a TRANSPORT on the battlefield. Each Waaagh! and Speedwaaagh! has two stages. The first begins when it is called and lasts until your next Command phase starts; the second then lasts until the start of the Command phase after that, at which point the effect ends completely. A Great Waaagh! counts as calling a Waaagh! and a Speedwaaagh! simultaneously, both active from the moment it is called, with stages running as described. WAAAAGH! Stage 1, Call Da Waaagh!: your ORKS CORE and ORKS CHARACTER units can declare a charge in a turn they Advanced; your ORKS models get 1 added to their Strength and Attacks characteristics and gain a 5+ invulnerable save. Stage 2, Get Stuck In!: your ORKS models get 1 added to their Strength and Attacks characteristics and gain a 6+ invulnerable save. SPEEDWAAAGH! Stage 1, Da Big Race: your ORKS models ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced; whenever one of your ORKS VEHICLE or ORKS BIKER models shoots a Dakka weapon, it makes 1 additional attack with it; and ranged attacks by models in your ORKS VEHICLE and ORKS BIKER units get their Armour Penetration improved by 1. Stage 2, Give 'Em Sum Dakka!: ranged attacks by models in your ORKS VEHICLE and ORKS BIKER units get their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

7b972ebaa2a0.name: Brutal but Kunnin
7b972ebaa2a0.plain: When this WARLORD fights and aims all its attacks at one enemy unit, it can then make extra attacks against that unit. Once those attacks are resolved, it can make one more attack against that unit for each of its attacks in that fight that didn't reach the Inflict Damage step of the attack sequence.

7ba5158974fc.name: Outriders
7ba5158974fc.plain: Instead of deploying this unit on the battlefield, you can place it on the army's flank during deployment. If so, it arrives at the end of one of your Movement phases: set it up on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from every enemy model and wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge.

7bf1ab169621.name: Junkboss
7bf1ab169621.plain: This WARLORD gets a 4+ invulnerable save.

7cc4d227b28c.name: Squigboss
7cc4d227b28c.plain: For every <CLAN> SQUIGHOG BOYZ unit in a Detachment, that Detachment can also include up to two <CLAN> NOB ON SMASHA SQUIG units that don't use up any Battlefield Role slots.

7cd4e7c92b44.name: Turbo-boost
7cd4e7c92b44.plain: When this unit Advances, don't roll; instead add 6" to its Move characteristic for that Movement phase.

7daf11a79828.name: Accidental Figurehead (Aura)
7daf11a79828.plain: Aura: while one of your GOFF GRETCHIN units is within 12" of this model, its models may use this model's Leadership characteristic in place of their own.

7e05733728df.name: Explodes
7e05733728df.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

7ef0bbce859b.name: Da Gyroblitza
7ef0bbce859b.plain: When chosen to fight, this model can direct its full number of attacks at each enemy unit within Engagement Range.

7f40dd2a2ba9.name: Snakebites
7f40dd2a2ba9.plain:
Units with this kultur:
- can't be wounded by an attack with an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, unless that attack's Strength characteristic is 8 or more. This applies whatever abilities the weapon or the attacking model has.
- add 1 to the wound roll of melee attacks made by their SQUIG models in a turn when the unit has made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention.

8129e268ca64.name: Kunnin’ Infiltrator
8129e268ca64.plain: When you set this model up during deployment, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from both the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

816da5eb299e.name: Fuel-mixa Grot
816da5eb299e.plain: Once per battle, when this model Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, its Move characteristic is increased by 9" until the phase ends.

846fd1cedcd0.name: Shunta
846fd1cedcd0.plain: If any VEHICLES suffer a wound from this weapon, they can't Advance in the following turn.

855276e3319a.name: Grot Gunner
855276e3319a.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll whenever this model attacks with a big shoota.

85d054a0bf0a.name: 'Ere We Go!
85d054a0bf0a.plain: Units with this ability may re-roll their charge rolls.

85e08c8e338c.name: Blitza Dakka
85e08c8e338c.plain: Use in your Shooting phase when one of your SPEED MOB units is picked to shoot. For the rest of the phase, its models' attacks against an enemy unit within 12" re-roll hit rolls of 1, or hit rolls of 1-2 if the unit has the KUSTOM BOOSTA-BLASTAS keyword.

8617838f5df4.name: Bursta Kannon
8617838f5df4.plain: Blast. Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks with this weapon against a target within half range.

863fbbecbd94.name: Grot Gunner
863fbbecbd94.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll whenever this model attacks with a twin big shoota.

86d7d77cbf93.name: Force Field Boosta
86d7d77cbf93.plain: Once per battle, as your opponent's Shooting phase begins, choose a model of yours that carries a kustom force field. Until the turn ends, the kustom force field's ability is replaced by: 'Aura: models in friendly ORKS units within 9" of the bearer have a 5+ invulnerable save.' When this turn ends, the kustom force field overloads and can't be used again for the rest of the battle.

88d32acffdb2.name: Bonebreaker Ram
88d32acffdb2.plain: Whenever this model fights in a turn in which it made a charge move, its Attacks characteristic is increased by D6 until that fight has been resolved.

88ea452e2f42.name: Kustom Ammo
88ea452e2f42.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, choosing one of your DREAD WAAAGH! units. This phase, it can shoot twice with every ranged weapon it has.

8ba3c5ec36d6.name: Big Gob
8ba3c5ec36d6.plain: This WARLORD's aura abilities have their range increased by 3", up to a maximum of 9".

8c80253696e6.name: Ramming Speed
8c80253696e6.plain: Use in your Charge phase when one of your ORKS VEHICLE units is picked to charge. For the rest of the phase, its charge rolls use 3D6, and whenever it ends a charge move, you pick an enemy unit in Engagement Range of it and roll a D6: on a 2+ that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

8ca1478716c8.name: Ded Sneaky
8ca1478716c8.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, if the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rule: pick one BLOOD AXES INFANTRY unit from your army (not MEGA ARMOUR units) within 3" of any battlefield edge and put it into Strategic Reserve.

8d5a68b77ea2.name: Da Blitzshouta
8d5a68b77ea2.plain: When your Shooting phase begins, if the bearer is embarked inside a BLITZ BRIGADE BATTLEWAGON, choose one enemy unit that the BATTLEWAGON can see. Until the phase ends, when your BLITZ BRIGADE units within 6" of that BATTLEWAGON attack the chosen enemy unit, re-roll their hit rolls of 1.

8de06e99d463.name: Lotsa Squigs!
8de06e99d463.plain: In your Shooting phase, pick one RUKKATRUKK SQUIGBUGGIES unit from your army. That unit gets 1 more squig mine remaining.

8de2a916078e.name: Ram
8de2a916078e.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge, choose an enemy unit it is in Engagement Range of and roll a D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

8f92407a1d01.name: Enraged Demise
8f92407a1d01.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it becomes enraged, and every unit within 6" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

8fbf63f729e5.name: Grot Orderly
8fbf63f729e5.plain: Once per battle, if you roll a 1 for the bearer's Sawbonez ability, you can re-roll that dice. (A Grot Orderly model can be placed beside the unit as a reminder and removed once used; it is not a model for any rules purposes.)

910a88b9340a.name: Madboyz
910a88b9340a.plain:
The unit gains the MADBOYZ keyword and a random ability, rolled at the start of each battle round, that lasts until the end of that round. Only BIKER, CAVALRY, CHARACTER or MOB units can take this. At the start of each battle round, roll a D3 to find out which of these abilities the MADBOYZ unit has until the round ends:
1. Rash: when a MADBOYZ unit piles in, it can move up to 6" rather than 3".
2. Inspired: when a MADBOYZ unit is picked to shoot or fight, one hit roll and one wound roll for that unit's attacks can be re-rolled.
3. Frenzied: add 1 to the Strength characteristic of every melee attack made by a MADBOYZ model.

925600261df7.name: Sneaky Gitz
925600261df7.plain: The unit gains the SNEAKY GITZ keyword and an ability that improves its melee Armour Penetration against targets in cover. Sneaky Gitz: when a SNEAKY GITZ model makes a melee attack against a target that is receiving the benefits of cover, that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic is improved by 1. Only BOYZ, KOMMANDOS, NOB or WARBOSS units can take this.

9296d21018e5.name: Bigbomm
9296d21018e5.plain: This model can drop one bomm once per battle for each bigbomm it has. If it does, in your Movement phase, after it makes a Normal Move or Advances, you can pick one enemy unit it moved over during that move. Roll one D6 per model in that enemy unit (no more than five D6); the unit suffers 1 mortal wound for each 5+. Since the January 2023 update, you can only do this if this model is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

93377bd2598b.name: Squiggoth (Kannon)
93377bd2598b.plain: This model can carry up to 6 FLASH GITZ or <CLAN> INFANTRY models as a transport. MEGA ARMOUR and JUMP PACK models can't embark in it.

9347443a1713.name: Throat Slitta
9347443a1713.plain: This model's attacks get 1 added to the wound roll if it is within 1" of a terrain feature when it attacks.

936349a8bf95.name: Get Da Loot
936349a8bf95.plain: Use as your Command phase begins. Choose one of your FREEBOOTERZ INFANTRY units on the battlefield; it has the Objective Secured ability until your next Command phase starts.

9386917002b5.name: Duk An' Kuvva
9386917002b5.plain: When your opponent's Shooting phase starts, if this WARLORD is wholly inside an Area Terrain feature, shield one unit there from distant ranged attacks. Pick one of your BLOOD AXES BOYZ or BLOOD AXES KOMMANDOS units that is wholly inside that feature. Until the phase ends, enemy models that are not within 12" of that terrain feature can't choose that unit as a target for ranged attacks.

93a804a0bfb9.name: Supa-cybork Body
93a804a0bfb9.plain: The bearer's Wounds characteristic goes up by 1, and its Toughness characteristic becomes 6.

94d83ff8e9da.name: Gloryboyz
94d83ff8e9da.plain: Use in your Charge phase when one of your BLOOD AXES units makes a charge move. Choose one enemy unit that was among the targets of that charge. For the rest of the phase, charge rolls get 2 added whenever a BLOOD AXES STORMBOYZ unit declares a charge against that enemy unit.

952eebde7b49.name: Extra-Kustom Weapon
952eebde7b49.plain: Only a model with a kustom mega-slugga or kustom mega-blasta can have this. Whenever this model shoots with either of those weapons, it makes one extra attack with it.

955d276022ec.name: Big Bomb
955d276022ec.plain: Once per battle, after the bearer makes a Normal Move or Advances in your Movement phase, pick a point on the battlefield that it passed over this phase, then roll a D6 for every unit within 3" of that point. Subtract 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit (unless it is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit). On a 4+ the unit takes D3 mortal wounds. Since the January 2023 update, this only works if the bearer is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

95a742218421.name: Mekaniak
95a742218421.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may repair one of your <CLAN> VEHICLE models within 3" of it; that VEHICLE model gets back 1 lost wound. A model can't be repaired more than once in the same turn.

966a7bd394d8.name: Stikkbomb Launcha
966a7bd394d8.plain: You can only fire this weapon once per battle.

96773fa4ab11.name: Da Ded Shiny Shoota
96773fa4ab11.plain: Only a model with a kustom shoota can have this. It takes the place of the kustom shoota and uses the profile listed for this Relic.

9696d77371e8.name: Stompamatic Pistons
9696d77371e8.plain: Only a DEFF DREAD, GORKANAUT or MORKANAUT model can have this. This model's Move characteristic is increased by 3", and you add 1 to its Advance rolls.

970ee9ad8923.name: Dok’s Tools (Aura)
970ee9ad8923.plain: Aura: while one of your <CLAN> INFANTRY, <CLAN> BIKER or <CLAN> CAVALRY units is within 3" of this model, roll a D6 whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound; on a 6, the wound is not lost.

973ca68923d3.name: Chop and Krush
973ca68923d3.plain: If this model carries any two melee weapons, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic.

9741c6be2b49.name: Supersonic
9741c6be2b49.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, first turn it on the spot by up to 90 degrees (this doesn't count towards the distance it moves), then move it straight forwards. It can't turn again after that first pivot.

975b21770a3a.name: Runtherd (Restriction)
975b21770a3a.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each Detachment must contain at least one GRETCHIN INFANTRY unit for every RUNTHERD unit in it. RUNTHERD units don't use up any Detachment slots.

97640e5f7ef7.name: Prophet of Gork and Mork
97640e5f7ef7.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. Also, it can't lose more than 4 wounds in any single phase.

97a80c31c001.name: Big Red Button (Looted Vehicle)
97a80c31c001.plain: Once per battle, at the start of the Shooting phase, the Looted Vehicle's driver can press the red button on his dashboard. If he does, roll a D3 on the table to find out what happens.

97ad04c1eff6.name: Da IronGob
97ad04c1eff6.plain: Only a GOFF model can have this. After the bearer has made its close combat attacks, and before it consolidates, you may pick one enemy unit within 1" of it and roll a D6: on a 2+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

97b271d05b31.name: Psyker
97b271d05b31.plain: Psychic powers: Smite, plus 2 powers from the Beasthead discipline.

97e2aeb8d766.name: Surprize!
97e2aeb8d766.plain: Use when the Fight phase starts. Choose one BLOOD AXES KOMMANDOS unit wholly within an Area Terrain feature. For the rest of the phase: any enemy unit in Engagement Range of the Kommandos can't use rules that let it fight first, and it is never treated as having made a charge move this turn, regardless of its abilities. In addition, attacks against that unit subtract 1 from their hit rolls.

980b8b0b20ea.name: Targetin' Squig
980b8b0b20ea.plain: When this model attacks with its shoota, or with a Relic that took the place of its shoota, add 1 to the hit roll.

982e1997206c.name: Throat Slittas
982e1997206c.plain: Melee attacks by models in this unit get 1 added to the wound roll if the attacking model is within 1" of a terrain feature.

9830acf9c5b0.name: Squig Hound
9830acf9c5b0.plain: Aura: while one of your GRETCHIN units is within 3" of the bearer, its models ignore modifiers to Combat Attrition tests. The bearer gains this as its Squig Hound (Aura) ability.

98f38313a552.name: Grot-Guided Bomm
98f38313a552.plain: Blast. This weapon can shoot at units the bearer can't see. The bearer can shoot it only once per battle. For every attack made with it, the bearer's Ballistic Skill counts as 2+.

9978d44bc129.name: Dread Saw
9978d44bc129.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with each dread saw it has.

9add14bff973.name: Gitstoppa Shells
9add14bff973.plain: Add 1 to the Strength and Damage of the Shoota or Kustom Shoota profile of the model's weapon, and improve that weapon's AP by 1. Only a model with a Kustom Shoota, a Kombi Weapon with Skorcha or a Kombi Weapon with Rokkit Launcha can take this.

9b0df22063a2.name: Big Gunz
9b0df22063a2.plain: When this unit is first placed on the battlefield, every Big Gun must be within 6" of at least one other Big Gun, and each grot krew within 1" of its own Big Gun. After that, each Big Gun acts on its own and counts as a separate unit for all rules purposes.

9bd32f0db150.name: Grot Guided Bomm (Fighta-Bommer)
9bd32f0db150.plain: Blast. This weapon can shoot at units the bearer can't see. The bearer can only fire it once per battle. For attacks with this weapon, the bearer's Ballistic Skill is 2+.

9cf910546859.name: Waaagh!
9cf910546859.plain:
Once per battle, in your Command phase, if your WARLORD is a WARBOSS, you can call a Waaagh! (the WARBOSS has to be on the battlefield or inside a TRANSPORT that is itself on the battlefield). If your WARLORD is a SPEEDBOSS, you can instead call a Speedwaaagh! once per battle in your Command phase; the SPEEDBOSS has to be on the battlefield. With GHAZGHKULL THRAKA as your WARLORD, the alternative is to call a Great Waaagh! (GHAZGHKULL THRAKA has to be on the battlefield or inside a TRANSPORT that is itself on the battlefield). A Great Waaagh! counts as calling a Waaagh! and a Speedwaaagh! together, so both are active from that moment.

Waaagh! and Speedwaaagh! both run in 2 stages. Stage 1 begins when it is called and ends at the start of your next Command phase. Stage 2 then begins and ends at the start of your following Command phase, at which point the effect is over.

Waaagh! Stage 1 (Call Da Waaagh!): your ORKS CORE and ORKS CHARACTER units can declare a charge even if they Advanced this turn; your ORKS models get 1 extra Strength and 1 extra attack (add 1 to both characteristics); and your ORKS models have a 5+ invulnerable save.
Waaagh! Stage 2 (Get Stuck In!): your ORKS models still add 1 to their Strength and Attacks characteristics, and have a 6+ invulnerable save.

Speedwaaagh! Stage 1 (Da Big Race): your ORKS models ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn when their unit Advanced; whenever one of your ORKS VEHICLE or ORKS BIKER models shoots a Dakka weapon, it makes 1 extra attack with it; and ranged attacks by models in your ORKS VEHICLE or ORKS BIKER units have their Armour Penetration improved by 1.
Speedwaaagh! Stage 2 (Give 'Em Sum Dakka!): ranged attacks by models in your ORKS VEHICLE or ORKS BIKER units still have their Armour Penetration improved by 1.

9d48afe7617d.name: Fists of Gork
9d48afe7617d.plain: BLESSING, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, choose one of your ORKS CHARACTER models within 12" of this PSYKER that it can see. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, that model's Strength and Attacks characteristics are each increased by 2, or by 3 instead if the Psychic test result was 11 or higher.

9e95426bd4d7.name: Fuel Mixa Grot
9e95426bd4d7.plain: Once per battle, when this model Advances, skip the Advance roll; instead, its Move characteristic is increased by 9" until the phase ends.

9ede23ff7b74.name: Noise Box
9ede23ff7b74.plain: Aura: enemy units within 6" of this model have their models' Leadership reduced by 1, and Combat Attrition tests taken for them are reduced by 1. If this model has destroyed any CHARACTER units during the battle, the Leadership penalty is 3 instead.

9fe183d574b1.name: Gargantuan
9fe183d574b1.plain: This model can still charge in a turn it Fell Back. When it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it may pass through models (other than VEHICLE or MONSTER models) as though they were not there.

a1f636c78e02.name: Squig Mine
a1f636c78e02.plain: If this unit still has squig mines, it can release one at the end of your Movement phase (once per turn only). Choose an enemy VEHICLE unit no more than 6" away and roll a D6. A roll of 3-5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds on it; a 6 inflicts D6 mortal wounds instead. Afterwards, this unit has 1 fewer squig mine.

a32b18104ba9.name: Kombi-rokkit
a32b18104ba9.plain: Before you choose targets, pick either or both of the profiles below to attack with. If you pick both, subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon for the rest of the phase.

a3b26bcef61c.name: Brogs Buzzbomb
a3b26bcef61c.plain: Only a SNAKEBITES model can have this Relic. It uses the weapon profile listed for it.

a3b3ce6ce454.name: Bubblechukka
a3b3ce6ce454.plain: Once targets are chosen, roll one D3 to see which profile the attacks use. If a unit has more than one bubblechukka shooting at the same target, roll the profile for each weapon separately before resolving any attacks against that target.

a4659e79dde2.name: Grabba Stikk
a4659e79dde2.plain: When the bearer fights, it can make 1 extra attack with this weapon.

a4cac341664d.name: Lumbering Strides
a4cac341664d.plain: Use in your Charge phase when the 'Ere We Go ability lets you re-roll a charge roll for one of your MORKANAUT, GORKANAUT or STOMPA units. Instead of re-rolling both dice, you may re-roll only one of them.

a57850c52d65.name: Da Rippa (Supercharge)
a57850c52d65.plain: When the bearer shoots, if you roll any unmodified hit rolls of 1 for attacks with this profile, the bearer takes 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon.

a623d990071c.name: Rigger Crew
a623d990071c.plain: When your Movement phase ends, the grot riggers of this model may try to fix it: roll a D6, and on a 2+ it gets back D3 lost wounds. It can't be repaired more than once per turn.

a68aa0f1d16b.name: Kustom Mega-Slugga
a68aa0f1d16b.plain: If any of your hit rolls for this weapon is a 1, the bearer takes a mortal wound once all of the weapon's shots are resolved.

a6a0952db571.name: Wurrtower
a6a0952db571.plain: When you choose this weapon to shoot, if the bearer successfully manifested any psychic power this turn, its Type becomes Assault D3. Attacks made with this weapon always hit the target automatically.

a79013f72baf.name: One Scalpel Short of a Medpack
a79013f72baf.plain: This model can charge even in a turn in which it Advanced or Fell Back. At the start of the Charge phase, if it is able to charge, it must declare a charge, and the nearest enemy unit must be one of its targets.

a79ef6654a25.name: Killa Reputation
a79ef6654a25.plain:
This model:
- subtracts 1 from the Leadership characteristic of models in any enemy unit within 3" of it. While that enemy unit is within 3", Combat Attrition tests taken for it also have 1 subtracted.
- adds 1 to the Leadership characteristic of models in your FREEBOOTERZ units while they are within 6" of it.

a87eaf0f426c.name: Dok’s Tools
a87eaf0f426c.plain: Whenever a <CLAN> INFANTRY or <CLAN> BIKER model within 3" of any friendly <CLAN> PAINBOYS would lose a wound, roll a D6; on a 6, the wound is not lost.

a96bca6bdf24.name: Fortress on Wheels
a96bca6bdf24.plain: Only a TRUKK or WAGON model can have this. This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

a9d599a408da.name: Raised Suspenshun
a9d599a408da.plain: Only a SPEED MOB VEHICLE model can have this. Even while this model is within Engagement Range of enemy models, it can still make ranged attacks at enemy units that are not within its Engagement Range.

aca29a88db1f.name: Boom Bomb
aca29a88db1f.plain: Once per turn, if the bearer still has a boom bomb, it can drop it. To do so, after the bearer makes a Normal Move or Advances in your Movement phase, pick a point on the battlefield that it passed over this phase, then roll a D6 for every unit within 6" of that point. Subtract 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER unit (unless it is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit). On a 4+ the unit takes D3 mortal wounds, or D6 mortal wounds instead if the roll is a 6. No boom bomb can be dropped more than once per battle. Since the January 2023 update, this only works if the bearer is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

ad2d364d22b2.name: Nitnuckle and Lunk
ad2d364d22b2.plain: Once per turn, when Mek Boss Buzzgob repairs a GOFF VEHICLE model using his Mekaniak Boss ability, you may have his grot underlings help, letting that model regain 1 extra lost wound. This ability can be used only twice per battle. (Two Grot Oiler models can be placed next to Mek Boss Buzzgob as reminders, removing one each time it is used; they are not models for any rules purposes.)

ad7e38895973.name: Get Stuck in Ladz!
ad7e38895973.plain: Use in the Fight phase when one of your BOYZ or BEAST SNAGGA BOYZ units is picked to fight. For the rest of the phase, its models can move up to 3" extra whenever they pile in or consolidate. This doesn't stack with any other rule that increases pile-in or consolidation distance. It costs 1CP for a unit of up to 10 models, or 2CP for a larger unit.

adce0f7bdc76.name: Da Gobshot Blunderbuss
adce0f7bdc76.plain: Only a BAD MOONS model with a kustom shoota can have this. It takes the place of the kustom shoota and uses the profile listed for this Relic.

ae019425545d.name: Small Bomms
ae019425545d.plain: Twice per battle, after this model makes a Normal Move or Advances in your Movement phase, you may choose one enemy unit it passed over during that move. Roll a D6 for each model in the chosen unit (10 dice at most); for each 5+ the unit suffers 1 mortal wound. Since the January 2023 update, this only works if this model is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

ae3fdced0352.name: Groundshaker Shells
ae3fdced0352.plain: Use in your Shooting phase as you pick a target for an 'eavy lobba. For the rest of the phase, whenever that model hits with a ranged attack from an 'eavy lobba against a target that isn't TITANIC and can't FLY, the target unit's models have their Move characteristic halved, and Advance and charge rolls for that unit are reduced by 2, until the start of your next Movement phase.

afdfdd44e07d.name: Musik
afdfdd44e07d.plain:
At the start of every battle round, choose one of the musik types below; this model performs it until that battle round ends.
- Goffik Rokk: while one of your GOFF INFANTRY units is within 6" of this model, its models get 1 added to their Strength.
- 'Eavy Metal: while this model is within 6" of a GOFF INFANTRY unit of yours that has the No Mukkin' About kultur, that kultur's extra hit is triggered on an unmodified 5+ instead of only on a 6.

b0ec62e10e72.name: Makari's Stabba
b0ec62e10e72.plain: For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals D3 mortal wounds to the target and ends the attack sequence.

b0f2972d01f9.name: Da Best Armour Teef Can Buy
b0f2972d01f9.plain: This WARLORD gets a 4+ invulnerable save and adds 1 to its armour saving throws.

b155e91c83e4.name: Surly as a Squiggoth
b155e91c83e4.plain: The first time this WARLORD is destroyed, you may roll a D6 at the end of the phase: on a 4+, it comes back with D3 wounds remaining. When it comes back, set it up on the battlefield as close as possible to where it was destroyed and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models. If you choose to roll, you don't use any rules that are triggered when a model is destroyed (such as the Orks is Never Beaten Stratagem).

waive.63: page number of the Orks is Never Beaten Stratagem in the official text; page references are left out

b21701c06b48.name: Big Killa Boss
b21701c06b48.plain:
This WARLORD:
- adds 2 to its Attacks when it fights while within Engagement Range of any enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER units, until that fight is resolved.
- adds 1 to the wound roll of its melee attacks against VEHICLE or MONSTER units.

b2a2e0f3948c.name: Counta-Taktics (Aura)
b2a2e0f3948c.plain: Aura: while one of your BLOOD AXES CORE units is within 6" of this WARLORD, it can perform Heroic Interventions as though it were a CHARACTER.

b30921cfee97.name: 'ard Case
b30921cfee97.plain: Increase this model's Toughness characteristic by 1; it can't use the Open Topped ability.

b39df7377c93.name: Kustom Shokk Rifle
b39df7377c93.plain: If one or more attacks with this weapon get an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer's unit suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon. Also, an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with this weapon deals 1 mortal wound to the target on top of the normal damage.

b45fa845c83d.name: Waaagh!
b45fa845c83d.plain: At the start of the Charge phase, any of your GOFF INFANTRY units within 6" of this model may still charge, even having Advanced this turn.

b4bd4a82aac8.name: Distraction Grot
b4bd4a82aac8.plain: Once per battle, when the bearer is chosen to fight, you can have models in this unit count as being within 1" of a terrain feature.

b561a5b95e0b.name: Traktor Kannon
b561a5b95e0b.plain: When attacking with this weapon: against a VEHICLE unit that can FLY, the attack's Damage is D6+3; against an AIRCRAFT unit, add 2 to the hit roll; against any non-AIRCRAFT unit, add 1 to the hit roll.

b5da9ca5db00.name: Bad Moons
b5da9ca5db00.plain:
Models with this kultur:
- add 6" to the Range characteristic of their DAKKA and Heavy weapons.
- improve a ranged attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 when it gets an unmodified wound roll of 6.

b5e2d915fc57.name: Snagged
b5e2d915fc57.plain: Whenever this model attacks with its stikka kannon and an enemy VEHICLE or MONSTER model (not TITANIC or AIRCRAFT models) loses any wounds from that attack, roll one D6. On a 4+, until the start of your next turn that enemy model can't end any kind of move more than 12" away from this model. The effect ends if this model moves for any reason or is destroyed.

b69b0f09a03e.name: Tank Hunters
b69b0f09a03e.plain: Whenever a model with this ability attacks a VEHICLE unit, add 1 to the hit roll for that attack.

b70b148859dd.name: Got’em Trapped
b70b148859dd.plain: Use when the Fight phase starts. Choose an enemy unit in Engagement Range of at least two of your BLOOD AXES units (CHARACTER units don't count). For the rest of the phase, each unmodified hit roll of 6 for a BLOOD AXES model attacking that enemy unit scores 1 additional hit.

b7c54c5682a9.name: Shoutin' Pole
b7c54c5682a9.plain: The bearer has the Warboss, Beastboss or Flashiest Gitz aura ability of any WARBOSS model embarked on this TRANSPORT, for as long as that model is embarked.

b82f96349b10.name: Tankbusta Bomb
b82f96349b10.plain: Use in the Fight phase when one of your ORKS TANKBUSTA BOMBS units is picked to fight. Choose a model in it: this phase that model makes just one attack, which has to target an enemy VEHICLE unit. If that attack hits, the target takes 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence ends.

b864bd608be2.name: More Dakka!
b864bd608be2.plain: Use in your Shooting phase when one of your ORKS units is picked to shoot. For the rest of the phase, when you work out how many attacks its Dakka weapons make, treat them as within half range.

b9ed55e7c58a.name: Gaze of Gork
b9ed55e7c58a.plain: Before you choose targets, pick which of this weapon's profiles to attack with.

bacde5217fc7.name: Lifta-Droppa
bacde5217fc7.plain: Blast. Attacks with this weapon hit automatically. For each hit, don't roll to wound; instead roll 2D6, and if the total equals or beats the target's highest Strength characteristic, the target suffers 1 mortal wound.

bba61c7a40b6.name: Ammo Runt
bba61c7a40b6.plain: Once per battle, you can re-roll the hit roll for one ranged attack made by the bearer. (An Ammo Runt model can be placed beside the unit as a reminder and removed once used; it is not a model for any rules purposes.)

bcf8e2297d1a.name: Big an' Stompy
bcf8e2297d1a.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move over other models (except MONSTER and VEHICLE models) as if they weren't there; while doing so it can pass within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

bd014fb5aa9b.name: Kustom Red Button (Looted Wagon)
bd014fb5aa9b.plain: Once per battle, when your Command phase begins, you may have the driver push the red button on his dashboard. If you do, roll a D6 to see what happens. 1 SNACK DISPENSA: no effect. 2-3 BOOSTA: this model's Move characteristic is increased by 4" until your next Command phase. 4-5 MORE DAKKA: until your next Command phase, on this model's ranged attacks an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit. 6 HIDDEN ROKKITS: this model has 1 rokkit launcha until your next Command phase.

bd74f74776cb.name: Stampede
bd74f74776cb.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge, choose an enemy unit it is in Engagement Range of and roll a D6. On a 2+, that enemy unit takes D6 mortal wounds.

be602c5f599f.name: Flyboyz
be602c5f599f.plain: The unit gains the FLYBOYZ keyword and an ability that gives it light cover against ranged attacks from more than 6" away. Whenever a FLYBOYZ unit is targeted by a ranged attack from an attacker more than 6" away, the unit with this ability counts as having the benefits of light cover against it. Only BLITZA-BOMMER, BURNA-BOMMER, DAKKAJET, DEFFKOPTAS or WAZBOM BLASTJET units can take this.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"; book references are left out

be6c4ba678bb.name: 'Orrible Gitz
be6c4ba678bb.plain:
The unit gains the 'ORRIBLE GITZ keyword and this ability:
- An 'ORRIBLE GITZ unit has the Objective Secured ability.
- While any other unit (except RUNTHERD units) is within 3" of any 'ORRIBLE GITZ units, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack made by a model in that unit.
Only GRETCHIN CORE units can take this.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"; book references are left out

c071bed04fe6.name: Get Up in Their Faces
c071bed04fe6.plain: This WARLORD can shoot even in a turn in which it Fell Back.

c11947728009.name: Lobba
c11947728009.plain: Blast. This weapon can shoot at units the bearer can't see.

c1813ccc8a4b.name: More Gitz Over ’Ere!
c1813ccc8a4b.plain: Use in your Movement phase when one of your SPEED MOB units Falls Back. It can still shoot this turn even though it Fell Back. If it has the BOOMDAKKA SNAZZWAGONS keyword as well, then for the rest of the turn, each unmodified hit roll of 6 on its models' ranged attacks scores 1 additional hit.

c32874b6e113.name: Killsaw
c32874b6e113.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon. If the bearer has two of these weapons, it gets 1 extra attack with this profile when it fights.

c38809e2c590.name: Mega Charge
c38809e2c590.plain: Whenever you make a charge roll for this unit, roll one extra D6 and discard one of the dice.

c3b8a46f999b.name: Red Rolla
c3b8a46f999b.plain: Only a BONEBREAKA model can have this. It swaps this model's Bonebreaker Ram ability for Red Rolla: when this unit fights, if it made a charge move this turn, this model's Attacks characteristic is increased by D3+3 until that fight is resolved.

c3f3cadbdceb.name: Tough as Squig-hide
c3f3cadbdceb.plain: Use in any phase when one of your BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY, BEAST SNAGGA CAVALRY or BEAST SNAGGA MONSTER units is picked as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, any attack against that unit with an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 fails, no matter what abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.

c4aee3b27cac.name: Kustom Mega-Blasta
c4aee3b27cac.plain: Blast. If you roll any unmodified hit rolls of 1 for this weapon's attacks, the bearer takes 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting this weapon.

c4c5645e8794.name: Twin Skorcha
c4c5645e8794.plain: Attacks with this weapon always hit the target automatically.

c4c9ab7a6138.name: Mob Rule
c4c9ab7a6138.plain: As long as this unit is within 6" of one of your <CLAN> MOB units that is not under half strength, this unit never counts as being under half strength.

c4cd5001f662.name: Squig-hide Tyres
c4cd5001f662.plain: Only a VEHICLE model can have this (not WALKERS or AIRCRAFT). This model's Move characteristic is increased by 1", and whenever it Advances, add a further 2" to its Move characteristic.

c5f26a028408.name: Explodes
c5f26a028408.plain: Whenever a model in this unit is destroyed, roll one D6 before taking it off. On a 6 it blows up and every unit within 3" suffers D3 mortal wounds.

c7016ce57af0.name: Stompa Klaw
c7016ce57af0.plain: For attacks made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ deals D3 mortal wounds to the target on top of any normal damage.

c83fb546e842.name: Da Krunch
c83fb546e842.plain: WITCHFIRE, warp charge 6. If it is manifested, choose one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER and roll a D6 for every model in it; for each 6 rolled, that enemy unit takes 1 mortal wound. If the Psychic test result was 9 or higher, add 1 to those rolls.

c8889c124750.name: Squigosaur's Jaws
c8889c124750.plain: When the bearer fights, it gets 3 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can never make more than 3 attacks with it. For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 deals 3 mortal wounds to the target and ends the attack sequence.

c9238db3252e.name: Scoutin’ Ahead
c9238db3252e.plain: Instead of placing this unit on the battlefield during deployment, you can hold it behind enemy lines. If you do, it can arrive at the end of any of your Movement phases: set it up on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from every enemy model and within 14" of a battlefield edge.

c9cd7de68d7c.name: Grot Gunner (Boomdakka)
c9cd7de68d7c.plain: Models in this unit add 1 to the hit roll for their attacks with a grot blasta or big shoota.

c9e42c387f21.name: Grot Krew
c9e42c387f21.plain: Each Big Gun and its grot krew count as one model for all rules purposes. The krew has to stay within 1" of its Big Gun and can't be targeted or attacked on its own. Measure range and visibility for every attack by a Big Gun from the Big Gun itself, not from the krew.

ca9e447e1413.name: Opening Salvo
ca9e447e1413.plain: Use in your Shooting phase in the first battle round, choosing one of your BLITZ BRIGADE GUNWAGON units. Its weapons have double their Range characteristic for the rest of that phase.

cb963e1bcf45.name: Shoot 'Em Again!
cb963e1bcf45.plain: If this model stays stationary in its Movement phase, or moves a distance in inches that is less than half its current Move characteristic, then in the following Shooting phase it can shoot twice with its killkannon or lobba, but both times at the same target unit.

cbd2b6e1742d.name: Attack Squig
cbd2b6e1742d.plain: When a model with an attack squig fights, it can make 2 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can never make more than 2 attacks with it.

cc3f127d85d5.name: Speed King
cc3f127d85d5.plain: While one of your SPEED FREEKS units (other than a CHARACTER unit) is within 6" of this WARLORD, its models re-roll wound rolls of 1 for their attacks.

cda7fbca8a44.name: Zzap gun
cda7fbca8a44.plain: Whenever you choose this weapon to shoot, roll 2D6 to set the Strength of all its attacks. On an 11+, each successful hit deals D3 mortal wounds to the target on top of the normal damage, and the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound.

cdad96d2f1e6.name: Deathskulls
cdad96d2f1e6.plain:
Units with this kultur:
- can re-roll one hit roll or one wound roll for their attacks each time they are chosen to shoot or fight.
- roll a D6 each time one of their models would lose a wound because of a mortal wound: on a 5+, the wound is not lost.
- gain the Objective Secured ability if they are INFANTRY units.

cdcd57ee76e0.name: Grot Sponson
cdcd57ee76e0.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon.

ce51ab6fbe71.name: Da Revolushun! (Aura)
ce51ab6fbe71.plain: Aura: while one of your GRETCHIN units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to every Combat Attrition test taken for that unit.

ce73f1ae3808.name: Dread Klaw
ce73f1ae3808.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it can make 1 extra attack with this weapon.

ce99b967d17a.name: Gotcha!
ce99b967d17a.plain: Whenever an attack with this weapon successfully hits an enemy unit, that unit is grabbed by the bearer until the start of your next Movement phase. Whenever an enemy unit grabbed by the bearer is selected to Fall Back, you roll a D6 and add the bearer's Strength characteristic, and your opponent rolls a D6 and adds that unit's Strength characteristic. If your total beats your opponent's, the enemy unit can't Fall Back and must Remain Stationary instead.

ceb482118c34.name: Sawbonez (PainBoss)
ceb482118c34.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may heal one of your <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA INFANTRY, <CLAN> BIKER or <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA CAVALRY models whose unit is within 3" of it. If it does, roll a D6: on a 1, that model takes 1 mortal wound; on a 2+, it regains up to 2 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn.

ced928c9df9a.name: Grot Gunner (Warboss)
ced928c9df9a.plain: When this model attacks with its big shoota, or with a Relic that took the place of its big shoota, add 1 to the hit roll.

cf75ff0ea02d.name: Explodes (6+/3D6"/D6)
cf75ff0ea02d.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 3D6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

cffc0dd10edd.name: Monster Hunterz
cffc0dd10edd.plain: Use when any phase starts. Choose an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, and up to 3 of your BEAST SNAGGA units. For the rest of the phase, attacks by models in those BEAST SNAGGA units against that MONSTER or VEHICLE unit get 1 added to the wound roll.

d08d9edc5a00.name: Stompa-porta
d08d9edc5a00.plain: Use during deployment: instead of putting one of your STOMPA MOB units on the battlefield, you can set it up on a tellyporta pad. Units on a tellyporta pad can teleport in at the end of any of your Movement phases; place them on the battlefield anywhere more than 9" from any enemy models.

d10fefb0930f.name: Kustom Red Button
d10fefb0930f.plain: Once per battle, when your Command phase begins, you may have the driver push the red button on his dashboard. If you do, roll a D6 to see what happens. 1 Snack Dispensa: no effect. 2-3 Boosta: this model's Move characteristic is increased by 4" until your next Command phase. 4-5 More Dakka: until your next Command phase, on this model's ranged attacks an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit. 6 Hidden Rokkits: this model has 1 rokkit launcha until your next Command phase.

d16d4dc7f316.name: Extra Gubbinz
d16d4dc7f316.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the ORKS keyword: pick one ORKS CHARACTER model in your army and give it one Shiny Gubbinz (a Relic it is allowed to have). All Relics in your army must be different, and this Stratagem can't give a model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

d1bbf012dba6.name: Burn ’Em All!
d1bbf012dba6.plain: Use in your Shooting phase when one of your BURNA-BOMMER units makes attacks with skorcha missile racks. Once those attacks are resolved, 1 mortal wound is inflicted on every other unit within 3" of the target.

d2751a9d8a94.name: Youngbloodz
d2751a9d8a94.plain: Use in the Fight phase when a BLOOD AXES STORMBOYZ unit is picked to fight. For the rest of the phase, that unit's models get 1 added to their Strength characteristic. It costs 1CP if the unit has up to 10 models, or 2CP if it has more.

d2c0fefb860c.name: Thick Hide
d2c0fefb860c.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to this model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1, but not below 1.

d3a13e3fb34c.name: Shokka Hull
d3a13e3fb34c.plain: Only a VEHICLE model can have this. Whenever an enemy unit targets this model with any attacks in the Fight phase, roll a D6 once those attacks are resolved: on a 4+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

d3f554f7ae6a.name: Da Pain Klaw
d3f554f7ae6a.plain: If an attack with this weapon targets an INFANTRY or MONSTER unit and the hit roll is an unmodified 6, the target suffers 1 mortal wound as well as the normal damage.

d42a3e07fb26.name: Chaaaaarge!
d42a3e07fb26.plain: Use in your Charge phase when one of your Warbikers units makes a charge move. Until the turn ends, that unit's models get 1 added to their Strength characteristic, and their melee attacks have Armour Penetration improved by 1.

d585f88d9681.name: Periscope
d585f88d9681.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll whenever this model attacks with its kannon, killkannon, zzap gun or da booma.

d59988e28129.name: Red Gobbo
d59988e28129.plain: This model can be part of an ORKS Detachment and doesn't stop the other units in it from getting a Clan Kultur, though this model gains no benefit from any Clan Kultur itself. If it is your WARLORD, it has the Inspiring Leader Warlord Trait.

d67146d4e3b4.name: Sneaky Gits
d67146d4e3b4.plain: If a model in this unit is receiving the benefits of cover when an attack is allocated to it, armour saves against that attack get an additional 2 added.

d799d413063e.name: Fixin' Jobs
d799d413063e.plain: When your Movement phase ends, this model may fix one other friendly <CLAN> VEHICLE model that is within 1" (it can't fix itself). The repaired model gets back up to D3 lost wounds. No model can be repaired more than once per turn.

d7a4e7056e5b.name: Red Gobbo
d7a4e7056e5b.plain: This model can be part of an Ork Detachment and doesn't stop the other units in it from getting a Clan Kultur, though this model gains no benefit from any Clan Kultur itself.

d9aaaaa25e9d.name: Twin Big Skorcha
d9aaaaa25e9d.plain: Every attack made with this weapon hits the target automatically.

da22b4816dcb.name: Might is Right
da22b4816dcb.plain: This Warlord adds 1 to its Strength and Attacks characteristics.

da61a1220300.name: Weirdboy
da61a1220300.plain: Psychic powers: Smite, plus 2 powers from PotW (the Power of the Waaagh! discipline).

da73eeaa4201.name: Big Bomb
da73eeaa4201.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can drop a big bomb that deals D3 mortal wounds on a 4+ to each unit near a point it moved over. In your Movement phase, once the bearer has finished a Normal Move or an Advance, pick a single point on the battlefield that it passed over during this phase. For each unit within 3" of that point, roll a D6, subtracting 1 from the roll if the unit is a CHARACTER (VEHICLE or MONSTER units excluded). On a 4+, it takes D3 mortal wounds.

da9236fa31cd.name: Keep Up!
da9236fa31cd.plain: Add 2" to this model's Move characteristic while it is within 3" of a friendly GHAZGHKULL THRAKA unit.

dd3a41726285.name: Too Tuff for Deff
dd3a41726285.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. Whenever it would lose a wound, roll a D6: on a 5+, it keeps that wound.

dd43a733fadd.name: Sneakiest Git
dd43a733fadd.plain: If this model is receiving the benefits of cover when an attack is allocated to it, armour saves against that attack get an additional 2 added.

dddd868c79ac.name: Spiked Ram
dddd868c79ac.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge, choose an enemy unit it is in Engagement Range of and roll a D6. On a 4+, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

de8503adb940.name: Bionik Oiler
de8503adb940.plain: Only a model with a grot oiler can have this. This model can use its grot oiler twice per battle rather than once.

df080f088649.name: Spotted ‘Em!
df080f088649.plain: Use as your Shooting phase begins. Choose an enemy unit that one of your BLOOD AXES KOMMANDOS units can see and that is within 12" of it. For the rest of the phase, that enemy unit gets no benefit from cover against attacks by BLOOD AXES models in your army.

e0194bfbe836.name: More Dakka
e0194bfbe836.plain: Only a VEHICLE model can have this. Whenever this model shoots, roll a D6. On a 4+, each Dakka weapon it has makes 1 extra attack; on a 6, each Dakka weapon it has makes 2 extra attacks instead.

e0e586647b14.name: Dread Mob
e0e586647b14.plain: After this unit is first placed on the battlefield, if it contains more than 1 model, each of its models has to be placed within 6" of another model in the unit. Once that initial set-up is done, every model counts as its own separate unit.

e1373cd8d3be.name: Explodes
e1373cd8d3be.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

e248014a14f7.name: Burna Bomb
e248014a14f7.plain: Once per turn, the bearer can drop one of the burna bombs it still has. Do this in your Movement phase, once the bearer has made a Normal Move or Advanced: pick a point on the battlefield that it crossed during this phase. Roll a D6 for every model within 6" of that point, subtracting 1 from the roll for a CHARACTER model that is not a VEHICLE or MONSTER model. On a 5+, that model's unit suffers 1 mortal wound. No burna bomb can be dropped more than once per battle.

e2899ed5b588.name: Flakka Gunz
e2899ed5b588.plain: For attacks with this weapon, add 1 to the hit roll against a target that can FLY, and subtract 1 from the hit roll against any other target.

e4c107c1ef0a.name: Beast Snagga
e4c107c1ef0a.plain: Whenever a model with this ability attacks a VEHICLE or MONSTER, add 1 to the hit roll for that attack. In addition, all models in this unit have a 6+ invulnerable save.

e4ed165e6961.name: Sawbonez
e4ed165e6961.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may heal one of your ORKS INFANTRY or ORKS BIKER models whose unit is within 3" of it. If it does, roll a D6: on a 1, that model takes 1 mortal wound; on a 2+, it regains up to 2 lost wounds. No model can be healed more than once per turn.

e5b84c4dd23d.name: Crashin’ Through
e5b84c4dd23d.plain: Use in your Charge phase once one of your SPEED FREEKS units finishes a charge move. If it has the Spiked Ram ability, it can't use that ability this turn. Pick one enemy unit within 1" of it, then roll a D6 for each model in the SPEED FREEKS unit (up to six D6). If the SPEED FREEKS unit has the BIKER keyword, each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the enemy unit. If it has the VEHICLE keyword (but not MEGATRAKK SCRAPJETS or KUSTOM BOOSTA-BLASTAS units), each 4+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on the enemy unit. If it has the MEGATRAKK SCRAPJETS or KUSTOM BOOSTA-BLASTAS keyword, each 2-5 inflicts D3 mortal wounds and each 6 inflicts 2D3 mortal wounds on the enemy unit.

e6b02ccc9cd1.name: Beastscent
e6b02ccc9cd1.plain: MALEDICTION (warp charge 5): if it is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. That unit can't get the benefits of cover against attacks made by BEAST SNAGGA units in your army until your next Psychic phase begins.

e6baba9dc072.name: Riding Shotgun
e6baba9dc072.plain: When a model in this unit shoots, it can fire Grenade and Pistol weapons as well as its other weapon types.

e7b2c9f38b68.name: Keepin' Order
e7b2c9f38b68.plain: If a GOFF unit is within 3" of any of your GOFF units with this ability when its Morale test is taken, roll a D6 for every model that flees from it: on a 6, that model does not flee.

e829102513c5.name: Cuttin’ Flames
e829102513c5.plain: Use in the Fight phase, choosing one of your BURNA BOYZ units. For the rest of the phase, melee attacks made by Burna Boy models in that unit have an Armour Penetration of -2, and no ability or rule that improves Armour Penetration can improve this.

ea34d71cb9d5.name: 'Eavy Lobba
ea34d71cb9d5.plain: Blast. This weapon can shoot at units the bearer can't see.

ea4dcec9b7b8.name: Stomp, Stomp, Stomp!
ea4dcec9b7b8.plain: Use as the Fight phase begins. Choose one of your STOMPA MOB units that is within 1" of any enemy units. For every enemy model within 3" of it, roll a D6: on a 6+, 1 mortal wound is inflicted on that model's unit.

ea7cec275255.name: Tide of Muscle
ea7cec275255.plain: In your Charge phase, when you choose an ORKS CORE unit from your army (not GRETCHIN units) to charge: that unit can ignore any or all modifiers to its charge roll.

eefc67feff20.name: Enraged Demise
eefc67feff20.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it becomes enraged, and every unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

efc93ab43520.name: Terrifying Killer (Aura)
efc93ab43520.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 6" of this model, its models have their Leadership characteristic reduced by 2 while there.

f01e434fc103.name: Big an' Stompy
f01e434fc103.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move over other models (except MONSTER and VEHICLE models) as if they weren't there; while doing so it can pass within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

f2a8d08367a5.name: Mystic Chanting
f2a8d08367a5.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, choosing one of your SNAKEBITES units. For the rest of the phase, it may try to deny one psychic power as though it were a PSYKER.

f3fedd6b7af6.name: Stikka Kannon
f3fedd6b7af6.plain: When the bearer attacks a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit with this weapon, you can re-roll the hit roll.

f4b39065da06.name: Fixin' Toolz
f4b39065da06.plain: Whenever a MEK or BIG MEK model uses its Mekaniak or Big Mekaniak ability while within 1" of the Mekboy Workbench terrain feature, the VEHICLE unit it repairs regains 1 extra wound.

f6cd6210fc81.name: Beastboss (Aura)
f6cd6210fc81.plain: Aura: while one of your <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA CORE or <CLAN> BEAST SNAGGA CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, its models add 1 to the hit roll for every melee attack they make.

f6e34729ac1e.name: Grot Gunner (Rukkatrukk)
f6e34729ac1e.plain: Whenever a model in this unit attacks with a heavy squig launcha, add 1 to the hit roll for that attack.

f6f9c61d5178.name: Explodes (6+/6"/D6)
f6f9c61d5178.plain: If this transport is destroyed, roll one D6 before any embarked models get out and before taking the model off the table. On a 6 it blows up, and every unit within 6" suffers D6 mortal wounds.

f77898aa485a.name: Hold On, Boyz!
f77898aa485a.plain: Use during your Movement phase, just before one of your <CLAN> BLITZ BRIGADE BATTLEWAGON models moves. Choose a friendly <CLAN> INFANTRY unit that is wholly within 3" of it and lift that unit off the battlefield. When the BATTLEWAGON has finished moving, place the <CLAN> INFANTRY unit back on the battlefield so it is wholly within 3" of the BATTLEWAGON and more than 3" away from all enemy models. The infantry unit isn't embarked in the Battlewagon, so it doesn't use up any of its transport capacity. For the rest of the phase it can't move again (but it is treated as having moved this turn for all rules purposes), and it can't charge this turn.

f8b65ec4f803.name: Ard as Nails
f8b65ec4f803.plain: Subtract 1 from the wound roll of every attack that targets this WARLORD.

f957bc3f22f0.name: Pyromaniaks
f957bc3f22f0.plain: If an attack made with a burna by this unit destroys an enemy unit, then until your next turn, this unit automatically passes every Morale test taken for it.

f98237099e3f.name: Cloud of Smoke
f98237099e3f.plain: Use as your opponent's Shooting phase begins, choosing one of your SPEED FREEKS VEHICLE units. Until the phase ends, if any friendly SPEED FREEKS VEHICLE unit is within 6" of the chosen unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack that targets that unit.

f9b47280a1c5.name: Kustom Red Button
f9b47280a1c5.plain: Once per battle, when your Command phase begins, you may have the driver push the red button on his dashboard. If you do, roll a D6 to see what happens. 1 Shouty Speakas: no effect. 2-3 Boosta: this model's Move characteristic is increased by 4" until your next Command phase. 4-5 More Dakka: until your next Command phase, on this model's ranged attacks an unmodified hit roll of 6 gives 1 extra hit. 6 Force Fields: this model gets a 5+ invulnerable save until your next Command phase.

f9c42b3813c9.name: Goffs is da Best
f9c42b3813c9.plain: While one of your GOFF CORE or GOFF CHARACTER units is within 6" of this model, models in that unit can re-roll the hit roll for their melee attacks.

f9dfcae32aeb.name: Da Revolushun!
f9dfcae32aeb.plain: While your Gretchin units are within 6" of this model, they can use its Leadership in place of their own.

fb8b962b18c4.name: ‘Da Boss’ Best Grot
fb8b962b18c4.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and GHAZGHKULL THRAKA is in a Detachment, MAKARI can join that Detachment without using up an extra Battlefield Role slot.

fc0502c122f3.name: Shokk Tunnel
fc0502c122f3.plain: If you roll 4+ for this unit's Advance roll, you can take it off the battlefield and place it again anywhere more than 9" from all enemy models. If you do, roll a D6, and this unit takes D3 mortal wounds on a 4+.

fec6206a9564.name: Blastajet Force Field
fec6206a9564.plain: Aura: friendly ORKS AIRCRAFT models within 9" of the bearer have a 5+ invulnerable save. Nothing can increase this aura's range unless a rule specifically says it does.
